'''Hanselle Renshar''' is an [[Andoran]] noble. He is the grandson of [[Arathelle Renshar]].

== Appearance ==
He is a slender young man.

== Activities ==
He is sent by Arathelle to ask [[Elayne Trakand]] for safe passage into [[Caemlyn]] for her and her colleagues forces.
